candidate_models.architecture: BERT sequence classifier, 2 transformer layers, hidden size 384, 12 attention heads, max positions 512, scalar output
candidate_models.published_artifact_size: 62.5 MB safetensors weight file; Hugging Face repository lists 611 MB total including exported formats
candidate_models.license: Apache-2.0 according to the model card metadata; review upstream terms before product deployment
candidate_models.score_semantics: Raw relevance logit; model card examples show unbounded outputs. Do not treat as probability.
candidate_models.shopassist_inference_status: not run; adapter implemented with local_files_only and CPU device; mocked scorer tests pass
candidate_models.assessment: Small candidate pool and lightweight two-layer architecture fit the intended reranking stage. English web passage training differs from product relevance, so transfer must be measured on independent ShopAssist labels before adoption.

selection: The model is the first candidate to validate once a local checkpoint is approved. It is not selected as the production method because its weights were unavailable locally and there are no independent relevance labels. Phase 11 default remains the Phase 10 RRF order.
